name: Claude Code Quota Badge
description: Surfaces your Claude Code subscription usage (weekly/monthly % used + burn-rate pace) as a SecondStatusLine segment. A throttled TurnEnd hook runs the vendored cclimits.sh (dandaka/ccquota, MIT) at most once every ~10 min and writes a one-line badge to ~/.aish/state/statusline/ccquota.txt, which aish's file-backed statusline reader (TASK-316) folds onto the status line. Pure plugin — zero core change.

throttle_seconds.description: Minimum seconds between cclimits.sh refreshes. cclimits drives Claude Code via tmux (~seconds), so keep this generous.
